title: 在 — location
explanation: 在 means "at/in/on" and marks location. For existence, use 在 + Place. For action at a place, the location phrase comes BEFORE the verb (unlike English).
structure:
Subj + 在 + Place          (existence)
Subj + 在 + Place + Verb      (action at a place)

examples.english: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.

notes: Word order: Place before verb (我在家吃饭, not 我吃饭在家). 常用位置词: 上 (on), 下 (under), 里 (in), 旁边 (next to), 前面 (in front), 后面 (behind).
